review_notes: I read the whole file and the imported SquareRoot.lean. I grepped Mathlib for ClassFunction, Frobenius-Schur and square-root concepts and found no matches. The file's new declarations are squareRootCount (a class function built from Nat.card of a subtype), the pairing and counting theorems, and frobeniusSchurIndicatorRow with its lemmas. frobeniusSchurIndicatorRow is a named specialisation of Representation.frobeniusSchurIndicator at irreducibleRepresentation k i. It provides the row-indexed API, and the docstring explains why it is kept. squareRootCount uses Nat.card on {g // g * g = x}, which is the standard Mathlib counting idiom, not a competing notion. I found no independent Mathlib, Batteries or core counterpart to duplicate. I did not check the rest of the TauCeti library for duplicates among its own declarations.
